scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: Hey, who's there?
I am executing my mission with the Rebellion unit.

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: This place is dangerous and you must leave quickly. We are near the enemy base.

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: We are arranging the situation inside the base. We cannot let you in yet.

^0000ffSeems like the base has been arranged inside. ^000000
[Striker Unit Commander]
Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: By the way, did you receive a briefing from the general Julian? Come back after receiving the briefing.

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: Once we are ready for the operation, you will get in there with me.
^0000ffSeems like an adventurer without his/her unit (party) cannot enter.^000000

scripts.speaker: Striker Unit Commander
scripts.text: The field of operation is {0} Check whether the operation was applied properly.

^ff0000Goint to the outer boundary of Heart Hunter War Base without clearing the Heart Hunter War Base is prohibited. Also, you cannot enter the Heart Hunter War Base that has already been cleared. Please check your operation point^000000

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Stop, which unit are you from? According to your answer, we may have to suppress you using an armed force.
I am executing my mission with the Rebellion unit.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Hmm, you are our troop? Since the scouting is not over yet, don't wander around here carelessly.
^ff0000If you deal with monsters arbitrarily inside a dungeon, such as Monster taming, it will not be regarded as a normal progress. Please be aware of it.^000000

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Are you a deserter wandering around without a position?
^ff0000Only the party leader can talk to Julian in detail.^000000

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: We are arranging the situation inside the base. You cannot enter yet.
^0000ffSeems like the base has been arranged inside. ^000000

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Are you the augmentation force in striking Heart Hunter base? I think we met before.
Just a thought.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Well, it doesn't matter. You should have a rough idea of what's going on here. Just remember that it's not going to be an easy task.
Explain the situation to me.
No time, let's proceed now.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Sounds cool. You are like a foreign legion, so stay beside me during the operation.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Hmm, you haven't received a briefing yet? Since we don't have enough time, let me explain briefly.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: We don't have enough forces to strike the base.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: For the sake of mobility, we abandoned heavy firearms. Since our top priority mission is to occupy the base without destroying it much, most of explosive weapons have been excluded as well.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: If necessary, we can reinforce our firearms using the terrain features in the field... But it must be minimized.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: In any case, most of the operation must be anti-personnel damage and the base facilities have to be maintained whenever possible.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Our advance party has secured the boundary surface in the southern base. We will take that route to move to the central part. And each striker unit will move in an individual route.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: You are like a foreign legion, so stay beside me during the operation. Any more question? Of course, I won't take any, even though you have one.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: If you are ready, I will let you know the attack time.
I'm ready.
I need some more time.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: I see. Since we are in a hurry, complete your preparation quickly and let me know.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Have you been to the toilet? I was looking for you.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: If you are ready, I will let you know the attack time.
I'm ready.
I need some more time.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: I see. Since we are in a hurry, complete your preparation quickly and let me know.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: After that, follow the instruction of the chief of your unit. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: There is a broad vacant land on the outer boundary of the base we have occupied. We built a training ground there, but the facilities are imperfect. I need elite personnel who can examine it.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Oh, isn't this the first time I tell you this? I would be glad if you can examine the facilities. What do you think?
Let me do it.
Maybe next time...

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: I got it. I asked a little too much.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: It will open soon. Once the gate to the base is opened, talk to the Striker Unit Commander over there and start.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: We don't have time to joke

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: We can just sneak in like this. But we'd better secure a path for the cleanup party. How can we do that?

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Why are they all coming out all of a sudden. Just hand me the gunpowder
Give him the gunpowder

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: It takes some time in assembling the explosive. You go up and check if there is any threat.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: If you find an enemy, don't forget to kill it without reporting me.

scripts.speaker: Ebel
scripts.text: You... Enemy? Our troop? Which side are you on?

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Hmm. The engineers need to repair the occupied base. It's time for battle force step outside.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: I'm talking to your leader now {0}.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: {0}, is this your first visit here?
Yes, it is.
No, I've been here before.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: You safely passed Section 1. Now help us with the defense training for Section 2.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: This security system here controls plenty of system devices over there.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: If you activate the device, they will open a narrow passage you can barely go through.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Unless you activate the device, the defensive training does not start. Activate it when you are ready.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: We have something as the last resort, in case we fail to defend the base. It's time to test it now.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Enter the door in front of you.

scripts.speaker: Ebel
scripts.text: Are you my companion? Or an enemy? Which side are you on?

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Wait for a while {0} we will proceed once your unit leader comes.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: It took me more than a week until I was able to talk to her. Now she speaks well.
Are you close enough to call her by the first name?
I know. Let's start right now.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: No, don't look at me like that. This girl would never talk to other guys. So I became in charge of her.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: ... It's real.

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Hmm. Great. Let's start right away.

scripts.speaker: Ebel
scripts.text: Where did you learn the technique you have used a moment ago?

scripts.speaker: Ebel
scripts.text: Where did you learn the technique you have used a moment ago?

scripts.speaker: Ebel
scripts.text: You... You're stronger than me. I have never experienced this before...

scripts.speaker: Julian
scripts.text: Hmm. Good job. Let us leave the training ground. The gateway is upstairs. Go up the stairs behind me.
